nodes.description: Owner address state variable declared in Owned; initialized to msg.sender and used as the sole access-control authority for the GetToken contract.
Address of the ERC20 token contract that GetToken sells; set in the GetToken constructor and used as the target of every external ERC20 call.
Price of one token unit in wei (stored after multiplying by 1 szabo); drives BuyToken arithmetic and can be changed by the owner via SetPrice.
Owned constructor that assigns owner = msg.sender, establishing the initial privileged account.
onlyOwner modifier that reverts unless msg.sender equals the stored owner; applied to transferOwnership, WithdrawToken, SetPrice and WithdrawEther.
Owner-only function that emits OwnershipTransferred and transfers the owner role to newOwner.
GetToken constructor receiving _token and _sellPrice, storing the token address and scaling the price by 1 szabo.
Owner-only function that transfers tokens held by the contract to the owner through the ERC20 interface.
Owner-only function that overwrites sellPrice with newprice * 1 szabo.
Owner-only function that sends ethers to owner via owner.send when the contract balance is sufficient; returns the send result.
Payable function that computes tokens from msg.value/sellPrice, refunds excess ether to msg.sender and transfers purchased tokens; emits GotTokens.
Payable fallback function that forwards all plain ether transfers to BuyToken().
msg.sender used as the trusted owner identity in the Owned constructor and in the onlyOwner access-control check.
Low-level ether push to owner in WithdrawEther; return value is returned but the send is an external call that can invoke a contract owner.
Ether refund to the untrusted msg.sender inside BuyToken before the token transfer; classic reentrancy entry point since state (tokens/payable accounting) is read before the call completes.
External ERC20 transfer of purchased tokens to the untrusted msg.sender inside BuyToken, performed after the ether refund; target contract address comes from state variable token.
External ERC20 transfer draining the contract's token balance to owner inside WithdrawToken.
Unchecked multiplication in the GetToken constructor: _sellPrice * 1 szabo can overflow the 256-bit price value.
Unchecked multiplication in BuyToken combining the token balance with the price; overflow can make maxethers wrap and break the refund logic.
Unchecked division in BuyToken by the owner-controlled sellPrice; a zero or tampered price causes division-by-zero / bad token accounting.
External call into the token contract for balanceOf; the returned value is trusted for the price/refund calculation.
Unchecked multiplication in SetPrice; overflow of newprice * 1 szabo can silently corrupt sellPrice.
ERC20 token address parameter of the GetToken constructor, assigned to the token state variable.
Initial sell price parameter of the GetToken constructor, scaled by 1 szabo before storage.
Number of tokens the owner wants to withdraw, passed to WithdrawToken.
New token price supplied to the owner-only SetPrice function.
Amount of wei the owner wants to withdraw, passed to WithdrawEther.
Address that receives the owner role in transferOwnership.
Local in BuyToken holding the number of tokens the buyer receives (msg.value / sellPrice).
Local in BuyToken holding the contract's ERC20 token balance fetched via balanceOf.
Local in BuyToken holding the excess ether to be refunded to msg.sender (msg.value - maxethers).
Local in BuyToken holding total * sellPrice, the maximum ether accepted before a refund is due.

edges.reason: msg.sender is written directly into the owner state variable by the Owned constructor, trusting the caller as owner.
msg.sender is assigned to the owner privilege state variable, making an untrusted caller the initial owner.
onlyOwner compares msg.sender against the stored owner, so this gate is the only barrier protecting privileged functions.
The stored owner value is the reference used by onlyOwner to decide whether the caller is authorized.
The Owned constructor writes the owner state variable during deployment.
transferOwnership is guarded by the onlyOwner modifier, so the modifier controls execution of the function body.
WithdrawToken is guarded by onlyOwner, restricting the token drain to the owner.
SetPrice is guarded by onlyOwner, restricting price manipulation to the owner.
WithdrawEther is guarded by onlyOwner, restricting ether withdrawal to the owner.
The newOwner parameter flows into the OwnershipTransferred event and the owner state variable.
transferOwnership overwrites the owner state variable, changing the privileged account.
The _token constructor parameter is stored into the token state variable.
The _sellPrice constructor parameter feeds the unchecked multiplication _sellPrice * 1 szabo.
The result of the unchecked scaling multiplication is written into the sellPrice state variable.
The newprice parameter feeds the unchecked multiplication newprice * 1 szabo.
The unchecked scaled price is written into the sellPrice state variable from SetPrice.
The tokens parameter is the amount forwarded to the ERC20 transfer in WithdrawToken.
WithdrawToken executes the external ERC20 transfer of tokens to owner.
The ethers parameter is the amount passed to owner.send in WithdrawEther.
WithdrawEther performs the owner.send(ethers) external push of ether.
The destination of the ether send is the owner state variable address.
BuyToken reads the untrusted msg.sender as the buyer, refund recipient and event argument.
BuyToken performs the external balanceOf call on the token contract to size the purchase.
The external balanceOf return value is stored in the total local variable.
sellPrice is the divisor in msg.value / sellPrice, so an owner-set or overflowed price breaks the division.
The unchecked division result is stored in the tokens local variable used for the payout.
The token balance total is multiplied by sellPrice without overflow protection.
sellPrice is a multiplicand in total * sellPrice, so price corruption propagates into maxethers.
The unchecked multiplication result is stored in the maxethers local variable.
maxethers determines the refund amount change = msg.value - maxethers.
The refund destination of msg.sender.send(change) is the untrusted caller, who can reenter BuyToken.
The refunded change value is pushed to msg.sender before the token transfer completes.
The ERC20 transfer sends purchased tokens to the untrusted msg.sender after the ether refund.
The locally computed tokens amount is the value passed into the ERC20 transfer.
The token state variable supplies the target contract address for the ERC20 transfer to the buyer.
The token state variable supplies the target contract address for the ERC20 transfer in WithdrawToken.
The token state variable supplies the target contract address for the external balanceOf call.
The GetToken constructor stores the supplied token address into the token state variable.
BuyToken makes an external callback into the token contract controlled by state variable token, which can invoke back into the contract before accounting settles.
BuyToken makes an external ether callback to msg.sender, allowing the buyer to reenter the payable flow.
The payable fallback function delegates plain ether transfers into BuyToken.

normalization_plan.reason: _token is only consumed by the GetToken constructor to seed the token state variable, so it folds into that core function node.
_sellPrice is used only inside the GetToken constructor as input to the unchecked price scaling multiplication, folding into the constructor.
The tokens parameter exists solely to be passed to the ERC20 transfer inside WithdrawToken, so it merges into that core function.
newprice is the only input of the owner-only SetPrice function and merges into it.
ethers is only used to size the owner.send push inside WithdrawEther and folds into that core function.
newOwner is consumed exclusively by transferOwnership to update the owner state variable.
The tokens local is computed for, and immediately passed to, the external ERC20 transfer to the buyer.
total only holds the return value of the external balanceOf call and merges into that unsafe operation.
change is computed only to be refunded to msg.sender and merges into that ether-push operation.
maxethers is produced by the unchecked multiplication total * sellPrice and merges into that arithmetic operation.
